title: Some Gemini models do not support web search
body:
https://developers.googleblog.com/en/continuing-to-bring-you-our-latest-models-with-an-improved-gemini-2-5-flash-and-flash-lite-release/

`gemini-flash-latest`, `gemini-pro-latest`, etc. These models are not considered to be part of the Gemini 2 series, so incorrect parameters have been enabled.

https://github.com/vercel/ai/blob/92dadc07893b0525da8d08ab31930f55f0149611/packages/google/src/google-prepare-tools.ts#L75-L88

linked_prs.title: feat(google): add support for latest gemini model versions

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.  
This issue concerns incompatible parameters passed to LLM providers (Gemini models), specifically enabling unsupported features (web search) due to incorrect model identification. It matches the "Incompatible parameters to LLM providers" agent issue sub-category.
